claim: When a build misbehaves, drive JNext headless with scripts, screenshots and PC reads instead of reading static listings.

evidence.text: JNext headless before hardware rounds; it found that the intro's IM 2 vector is ROM 3BFF-3C00 (I = 3B) and hooks must leave those bytes FF.
evidence.quote: The intro uses IM 2 with I = 3B: ROM 3BFF-3C00 is its vector. Hooks must leave them FF; JNext headless found it.
